source: bench/real/r_p_crowdfund (pinocchio 0.8.4 + pinocchio-system 0.2.3, written for the bench)
about: Realistic clean program: every finding on it is false. Scored for rules only. Instructions by tag, accounts in index order. load_campaign checks owner (is_owned_by program id), exact length, tag and the address [campaign, creator, id] from the stored bump; load_receipt the same for [receipt, campaign, contributor] plus receipt.campaign == the campaign passed. Lamports only leave program-owned campaign / receipt accounts; sum(receipt.amount) == campaign.raised is kept by every instruction.

why.creator: Signer, pays the rent; stored as the campaign's creator. Permissionless by design (anyone runs a campaign).
why.campaign: Key == find_program_address([campaign, creator, id]); created through create_pda (CreateAccount, or top-up + Allocate + Assign for a pre-funded address) signed with the PDA seeds. goal > 0, deadline in (now, now + 90 days].

why.contributor: Signer; pays the contribution with a system Transfer (its own signature) and the receipt rent.
why.campaign: load_campaign; active and before the deadline.
why.receipt: Not yet a program account: key == find_program_address([receipt, campaign, contributor]) and created with those seeds; otherwise load_receipt (this campaign) and receipt.contributor == contributor.

why.contributor: Signer and key == receipt.contributor; amount <= receipt.amount.
why.campaign: load_campaign; active and before the deadline.
load_campaign; still active and past the deadline. Permissionless crank by design: the outcome (raised >= goal) is fixed by the stored values.

why.creator: Signer and key == campaign.creator.
why.campaign: load_campaign; state succeeded, set to withdrawn before the lamports (raised) move: one withdrawal only.
load_campaign; failed (contribution + receipt rent back) or withdrawn (receipt rent only).
why.receipt: load_receipt (of this campaign); zeroed and closed, so it cannot be refunded twice.

why.remaining pairs (receipt, contributor): each: load_receipt (of this campaign) and contributor key == receipt.contributor; the receipt is closed, so a repeated pair fails its second load. Permissionless by design: a refund can only reach the receipt's own contributor.

why.creator: Signer and key == campaign.creator.
why.campaign: load_campaign; active -> failed (contributors can then refund).

why.creator: Signer and key == campaign.creator.
why.campaign: load_campaign; active with nothing raised and no contributor yet; new goal / deadline checked like at creation.

why.creator: Signer and key == campaign.creator; receives the remaining (rent) lamports.
why.campaign: load_campaign; withdrawn, or failed with refunded == raised (no contribution left in it); data zeroed and closed.
